sessions.title: Diagnose the Five Big Ideas
sessions.zh: 五大主题诊断与错因分类
sessions.summary: Use an 18-minute original diagnostic to separate reading, tracing, concept and evidence errors before choosing repair work.
objectives: Identify decisive conditions before solving a question.
Trace current values instead of guessing program behavior.
Use evidence to classify errors and choose two repair targets.

blocks.title: Read conditions and set a goal
blocks.task: Review the five lenses and model how one constraint changes a conclusion.

blocks.title: Independent diagnostic
blocks.task: Complete Q01–Q10 in 18 minutes; record confidence before opening feedback.

blocks.title: Check and classify
blocks.task: Inspect feedback and give each error a primary cause with evidence.

blocks.title: Trace a concrete example
blocks.task: Predict the original assignment micro-case, reveal the trace and explain the divergence.

blocks.title: Repair a concept boundary
blocks.task: Use the five-bit and volunteer-sample cases to distinguish similar concepts.

blocks.title: Transfer to a changed case
blocks.task: Repair one incorrect and one guessed response; change one condition and justify the new result.

blocks.title: Exit plan
blocks.task: Submit two specific repair targets and name the evidence that will show improvement.

sessions.contentHtml:
1. Diagnose before choosing what to review

Use ten new, original questions to find repair targets across the five Big Ideas. The result is a small diagnostic sample, not an AP score prediction.

教师支持：不要把10题得分换算成AP等级。先看学生错误集中在哪些机制：读题条件、执行追踪、概念边界或证据表达；本节诊断用于选择补弱内容。

2. Complete Q01–Q10 in 18 minutes

Open the original diagnostic set

Work independently for 18 minutes. For every answer, mark confident or uncertain on paper. Read words such as exactly, at least, only, sorted and same before calculating. Do not open feedback until the independent interval ends.

教师支持：0–8分钟先讲方法，8–26分钟完整保留给独立10题。读题标记不意味着必须把题干所有字划线，只提取会改变结论的条件。自信度应在看答案前记录。

3. Micro-case: a condition changes the answer

Original review case. A club needs 33 distinct identifiers. Every identifier must use exactly five bits. Is that enough? Explain what must change if the club keeps all 33 identifiers.

Show answer and reasoning / 展开答案与解释

Five bits provide 2⁵ = 32 patterns, so 33 distinct identifiers do not fit. At least six bits are needed because 2⁶ = 64. The decisive conditions are “distinct,” “33” and “exactly five bits.”

A useful correction names the limiting quantity. “Use more memory” is less precise than identifying the number of available patterns.

教师支持：这里考的是模式数量，不是五位无符号整数的最大值31。要求学生区分32种模式与最大数31；这也是把条件标记转化为具体推理的示范。

4. Micro-case: save a value, then change a variable

Predict both outputs before running or revealing anything. Record the value of each variable after every assignment.

first ← 4
saved ← first
first ← first + 3
DISPLAY(saved)
DISPLAY(first)
Show answer and reasoning / 展开答案与解释
After statementfirstsaved
first ← 44not yet assigned
saved ← first44
first ← first + 374

The outputs are 4, then 7. The assignment copied the current value into saved; later changing first does not change saved.

If your prediction was 7, 7, classify the error as execution/assignment reasoning, then explain the exact statement where your model diverged.

教师支持：不能只抄最终4和7。让学生指出第二条赋值完成时saved存了什么；把错误定位到一个执行时刻，下一课的列表和过程追踪会沿用同一方法。

5. Turn feedback into an error record

Classroom tagEvidence to recordA useful repair
ConditionThe exact word or constraint I missedRestate the rule, then change one condition.
TraceThe first incorrect state or pathRebuild the trace from that point.
ConceptThe two ideas I confusedWrite a distinction and a counterexample.
EvidenceThe claim I could not justifyPoint to a value, code step or stated permission.
PacingWhere time was spent without progressSet a return point and finish other items.

Example: “A larger volunteer sample must be unbiased” confuses quantity with representativeness. Explain a selection or nonresponse mechanism; simply asking more volunteers may preserve the same bias.

Show answer and reasoning / 展开答案与解释

A defensible counterexample is a survey available only through one club’s app. More replies from those app users can still underrepresent non-users. Bigger is not automatically more representative.

教师支持：这些标签是本课程复盘工具，不是官方评分分类。一次错误可以有主因与次因，但本课每题先写一个可行动主因，避免笼统归咎于粗心。

6. End with two specific repair targets

Choose two questions: one incorrect answer and one correct answer you guessed. For each, write the decisive condition, a corrected explanation and a new case that would test the same idea. Assign each target to code/algorithms, data/networks/impact, or reading and pacing.

Exit check: explain the difference between “I now know the answer” and “I can apply the rule to a changed case.”

教师支持：70–85分钟让学生实际改一个条件并再答，教师按解释核查；85–90分钟收两项目标。不要以反复点击直到正确作为掌握证据。
homework: Revisit one missed diagnostic item without looking at feedback; explain why each alternative fails.
Create one small changed-case check for a repair target and state the expected result.
Keep your original answer, confidence and correction; do not replace the record with only a new score.
teacherNotes: 保留完整18分钟独立诊断，不用讲题挤占。10题只提供薄样本，不以总分预测AP等级。
要求圈定条件、显示追踪过程；错误标签是教学工具而非官方评分术语。
两项修复目标分别指向具体机制与证据，不写笼统“多刷题”。

sessions.title: Repair Code & Algorithm Reasoning
sessions.summary: A 20-minute targeted set followed by original list, return-position, parameter, boundary and search comparisons.
objectives: Trace edits using the current 1-based list indices.
Explain how RETURN placement and meaningful parameters affect execution.
Use boundary cases to test a correction.
Compare search costs under stated assumptions.

blocks.title: Choose a tracing target
blocks.task: Use the diagnostic record to identify one code or algorithm reasoning weakness.

blocks.title: Independent algorithms set
blocks.task: Complete Q11–Q20 in 20 minutes before opening feedback.

blocks.title: Repair list reasoning
blocks.task: Trace INSERT and REMOVE on the current list and justify both outputs.

blocks.title: Repair return reasoning
blocks.task: Trace the original buggy procedure, relocate RETURN and verify the changed behavior.

blocks.title: Test boundaries and compare search
blocks.task: Check parameter boundaries, zero iterations and sorted-search inspection counts.

blocks.title: Transfer the repair
blocks.task: Apply the explanation to an algorithms-set error or a new counterexample.

blocks.title: Exit explanation
blocks.task: Explain the distinct effects of parameter values and return position.

sessions.contentHtml:
1. Start at the first state change

The aim is to explain execution, not memorize a pattern. Track indices, argument values, branch decisions and the exact point at which a procedure returns. All code below is original review practice, separate from official Create work.

教师支持：先用R01记录选一个代码弱点。正式Create若尚未三项Final，不在本课让教师改学生正在提交的程序；这些原创小例独立于正式作品。

2. Complete Q11–Q20 in 20 minutes

Open the original algorithms set

Work independently. Draw a tiny list or trace table when needed. If you are unsure, record the first uncertain step rather than repeatedly changing the answer.

教师支持：10–30分钟完整独立作答，剩余时间用于实际修复。不要在限时中逐题宣布对错；评分反馈留到限时结束后。

3. List indices belong to the current list

items ← [2, 5, 8]
INSERT(items, 2, 7)
REMOVE(items, 4)
DISPLAY(items[3])
DISPLAY(LENGTH(items))

Predict the list after each edit and both outputs. AP list indices start at 1; INSERT places the new element before the current element at the specified position.

Show answer and reasoning / 展开答案与解释

After INSERT: [2, 7, 5, 8]. After REMOVE at the current index 4: [2, 7, 5]. The outputs are 5 and 3. REMOVE acts on the edited list, not the original positions.

教师支持：图只给初始位置，不提前填修改后答案。学生应在每次编辑后重画索引；误把8的旧索引3保留下来，属于当前状态追踪错误。

4. A return ends the procedure

This program is intended to sum all values below limit. For values [4, 10, 7] and limit 8, predict what the buggy procedure actually returns, then locate the smallest repair.

PROCEDURE sumBelow(values, limit)
{
  total ← 0
  FOR EACH item IN values
  {
    IF (item < limit)
    {
      total ← total + item
    }
    RETURN(total)
  }
}
Show answer and reasoning / 展开答案与解释

It returns 4 after processing the first item. RETURN is inside the FOR EACH body, so later items are never processed. Move RETURN after the loop:

PROCEDURE sumBelow(values, limit)
{
  total ← 0
  FOR EACH item IN values
  {
    IF (item < limit)
    {
      total ← total + item
    }
  }
  RETURN(total)
}

The repaired call returns 11 because 4 and 7 are below 8. The change in location, not a change in the comparison, repairs this bug.

教师支持：只改一处定位并复测。RETURN不是只跳出IF或本次循环，而是结束当前过程。此例考察位置和执行含义，不让学生背“所有RETURN都只能在最后”；提前返回在别的需求下可能正确。

5. Make the parameter and boundary visible

Use the repaired sumBelow. Predict the following before checking. Changing limit must affect which items contribute; equality matters because the comparison is strict.

CallYour predictionWhat it tests
sumBelow([4, 10, 7], 4)Write firstEquality excluded
sumBelow([4, 10, 7], 5)Write firstOne value included
sumBelow([4, 10, 7], 8)Write firstTwo values included
sumBelow([], 8)Write firstZero iterations
Show answer and reasoning / 展开答案与解释

The results are 0, 4, 11 and 0. The empty list leaves total at its initialized value, and RETURN after the loop still runs. The parameter changes membership in the sum; merely naming a parameter would not establish this effect.

教师支持：边界不是随机挑几个数字：4刚好等于列表元素，5跨过它，空列表检查零次循环。若改成≤，第一项结果会从0变4，要求学生用这个反例说明运算符的作用。

6. Same result can have a different cost

Compare a left-to-right linear search with binary search on the displayed sorted list. The linear search stops only when it finds the target or reaches the end. Count each inspected element once. How many inspections find 4? How many find 60? What happens when searching for 30?

Show answer and reasoning / 展开答案与解释
TargetLinear searchBinary search
41 inspection23 → 9 → 4: 3 inspections
607 inspections23 → 42 → 60: 3 inspections
307 inspections, not found23 → 42 → 31: 3 inspections, then interval empty

For 4, linear search happens to be cheaper. This does not overturn binary search’s better worst-case growth on sorted data. Binary search needs the ordering assumption; neither method can report a missing value as found.

教师支持：明确比较单位是一项元素检查，不是源码比较运算符计数。二分未命中时空区间结束；不能把31当作最近值返回。讲效率要区分具体输入与最坏情况，不背“二分每次都更快”。

7. Explain one repair without copying the example

Choose one algorithms-set error. State its first incorrect index, branch, return or comparison. Give a boundary test or counterexample that would expose the mistake, then explain why your correction changes the result.

Exit check: changing RETURN’s position and changing a parameter can both change output. Explain their different mechanisms.

教师支持：74–85分钟让学生实际重做专项错题或自造反例；85–90分钟检验是否能把“参数决定哪些值参与”和“RETURN决定何时结束”分开解释。
homework: Trace the repaired sumBelow with [3, 8, 12] and limit 8; record each running total and the return value.
Change the test from < to ≤ and identify a test that distinguishes the two versions.
For the displayed sorted search list, compare inspection sequences for target 16 and justify the stopping point.
teacherNotes: 参考课后题：sumBelow([3,8,12],8)=3；改≤则11；目标16线性3项，二分23→9→16也是3项。
空列表测试仅用于修正后的过程；错误版本可能没有返回，不能凭空赋0。
教师只讨论这些原创练习和符合反馈阶段的个人材料，不改尚在正式阶段的学生作品。

sessions.title: Data, Networks & Impact Evidence
sessions.zh: 数据、网络、社会影响与官方样题
sessions.summary: Complete the 18 official CED sample questions in 30 minutes, then test claims using original path, sampling and permission cases.
objectives: Distinguish official sample questions from released exam papers.
Justify network reachability with remaining links.
Use stated group weights and explain remaining sampling bias.
Separate permission from attribution when reading a case.

blocks.title: Orient to the source
blocks.task: Open the current CED samples and check page numbers, context and the 30-minute plan.

blocks.title: Independent official samples
blocks.task: Answer CED Q1–Q18 in 30 minutes without opening the key.

blocks.title: Compare with the official key
blocks.task: Use PDF page 194 and record decisive conditions for errors.

blocks.title: Prove a network claim
blocks.task: Trace the original graph under two failure sets and distinguish reachability from delivery.

blocks.title: Evaluate data and permission evidence
blocks.task: Calculate the library mixture and interpret the two supplied permission cards.

blocks.title: Transfer and repair
blocks.task: Rewrite one sample-error explanation and one original-case claim with a limit.

blocks.title: Exit distinction
blocks.task: Explain why an alternate route is not a universal delivery guarantee.

sessions.contentHtml:
1. Use the CED questions as official samples

Today’s independent set is the 18 multiple-choice sample questions in the current Course and Exam Description. These are official sample questions, not a released annual multiple-choice exam.

Open CED sample Q1–Q18 · PDF pages 182–192

Set aside 30 uninterrupted minutes. Use the full question context, including any reading passage. If the PDF does not jump, enter the PDF page number manually.

教师支持：8–38分钟独立完成Q1–Q18；PDF页码包含封面，不能和印刷页码混淆。先别打开答案页，完整阅读题组背景。样题反映题型，但18题不是70题完整选择题考试。

2. Check the official key, then locate evidence

After the independent interval, compare your choices with the official answer page. For each discrepancy, record the decisive wording and the concept, rather than only copying a letter.

After the 30-minute attempt: open the official answers

CED official answers · PDF page 194

Official source labels and course-topic mapping

教师支持：38–48分钟核答案与错因。教师不要把这18题重新计入本章40道原创题库；也不要把原题搬入原创题JSON。题源和评分对应以官方PDF为准。

3. Original network case: prove a path or a break

Only the four drawn links exist; all nodes are working. If A–T fails, can S still reach T? Give a valid path. If both S–A and S–B fail, can the remaining links restore reachability? Explain.

Show answer and reasoning / 展开答案与解释

After A–T fails, S → B → T remains a valid path. If S–A and S–B both fail, S has no outgoing link in this model, so it cannot reach T. Having two initial routes does not protect against every set of failures.

Reachability is a claim about a path. It is different from a claim that every packet arrives, arrives in order, or arrives quickly.

教师支持：学生必须给路径或断开的理由，不接受只写“有冗余所以可以”。先检查每一步边是否仍存在；把节点全好和只有四条边作为模型条件，避免学生自行加连接。

4. Original sampling case: mix and bias

A fictional library asks whether more charging points are needed. In this synthetic model, the shares answering that more charging points are needed are 25% among weekday users and 75% among weekend users. These fixed within-group need rates are not questionnaire participation rates. Using the supplied rates, calculate the sample estimate and the population-weighted reference. Explain one limitation of reweighting.

Show answer and reasoning / 展开答案与解释

Sample: 0.90 × 25% + 0.10 × 75% = 30%. Population-weighted reference: 0.60 × 25% + 0.40 × 75% = 45%. The reference is 15 percentage points higher. Matching group shares does not remove within-group nonresponse, selection or measurement bias; 45% relies on the supplied rates.

教师支持：这些都是合成数据，45%不被描述为现实真值。若学生把25%与75%直接平均得50%，让其指出用了什么未经给定的50/50权重。

5. Original reading case: access is not permission

Figure F

The creator permits reading only. A student wants to copy the figure into a public library page and add the author’s name.

Icon I

A simplified classroom card permits sharing and adapting if the creator is credited and changes are identified. The student recolors the icon.

For each item, give a supported next action. Identify which part of your reasoning is about permission and which part is about attribution.

Show answer and reasoning / 展开答案与解释

For F, get permission covering reproduction or choose a permitted replacement before reuse. Credit alone does not expand reading-only permission. For I, follow the given sharing/adaptation permission by crediting the creator and stating the recoloring. These are simplified case terms, not complete license texts.

教师支持：要求学生引用具体条款，不凭免费、在线或无水印判断。题目不需要法域例外或法律推测；合法使用与伦理评价也不应被混成同一个标签。

6. Repair a claim without overclaiming

Choose one CED sample error and one original case. Write: the supplied condition, the evidence, the conclusion, and a limit. Use a path for a network claim, a weighted calculation for a sampling claim, or an explicit permission for a reuse claim.

Exit check: why does “there is a backup route” not prove “every message will arrive”?

Show answer and reasoning / 展开答案与解释

A backup route supports connectivity under certain failures. It does not by itself establish a delivery protocol, eliminate loss, or cover all possible failures.

教师支持：78–86分钟把官方样题错因迁移到新情境；最后4分钟用一句因果解释检验是否能区分模型支持与没有检验的保证。
homework: Redo two missed CED sample questions and locate the condition that determines each answer; retain the original source labels.
For the library model, calculate a 50/50 sample mixture and explain why it differs from the population-weighted reference.
Write a one-sentence counterexample to either “more data removes bias” or “credit grants permission.”
teacherNotes: 课后50/50样本按给定率得50%，与60/40人口参考45%不同；权重不同，不自动说明某组数据造假。
R03全部18题为官方CED样题，原题/答案从现有PDF直接打开；不叫历年实考试卷、不算进40原创题。
网络例的断路结论依赖图中仅四条边且节点工作；对图外路径不做推断。

sessions.title: The 2026 Written-Response Paper
sessions.zh: 2026官方完整书面题组与证据讲评
sessions.summary: 10 minutes of preparation, 60 minutes of independent official written responses and 20 minutes reviewing the four written scoring rows.
objectives: Read the current prompt rather than substitute a memorized answer.
Support a response with precise evidence from personal program code.
Explain why the code produces the claimed behavior.
Use the four written scoring rows without treating practice as a full Create or AP score.

blocks.title: Prepare the context
blocks.task: Confirm that all three official components are final, or that the official task has not yet begun and separate personal practice material is being used. If the official task is in progress, postpone the guided lesson; changing programs does not bypass the written-response feedback restriction.

blocks.title: Independent 2026 written responses
blocks.task: Complete the full public 2026 written-response paper for 60 uninterrupted minutes, without the scoring guidelines.

blocks.title: Compare four written scoring rows
blocks.task: Open the official guidelines, locate evidence for each of the four written rows and revise an unsupported explanation without modifying the submitted artifact.

sessions.contentHtml:
1. Prepare a valid practice context · 0–10 min

Schedule this guided lesson outside the nine dedicated task hours. If all three Create components are final, you may use that work for guided review. If the official task has not yet begun, you may use a separate earlier personal practice program. If the official task has begun but any component is not final, postpone this guided lesson: switching to an older program does not permit teacher feedback on practice written responses.

Have a readable PPR and keep the corresponding full program for post-attempt checking. During the 60-minute attempt, use your PPR and the general reference information allowed in the exam, not extra access to the full program. If you have not yet begun the official task and use earlier work, label the attempt “personal practice program.” That can develop the reasoning skills, but it does not fully simulate using an official submitted PPR.

教师支持：先区分三状态：全Final可讲评；正式任务尚未开始可用旧个人练习；正式任务进行中则推迟本课指导讲评。换旧程序不能绕过practice WR反馈限制。准备10分钟不替学生制作PPR或挑截图；缺材料者记录缺口，不发全班可背的统一程序。

2. Complete the 2026 written-response paper · 10–70 min

Open the official 2026 complete written-response paper

Work independently for the full 60 minutes. Answer both questions and all four prompts using the supplied official directions and your own code evidence. Do not read the scoring guidelines during this interval.

This is the complete publicly released written-response paper. It is not a full AP exam simulation: the 70-question multiple-choice section and the Create artifacts are not being assessed here.

教师支持：保留连续60分钟，不边做边讲。不要把以往年份的通用“程序目的”回答套到2026年题干；命令、对象和条件必须从当前原卷读出。这里链接原题，不复制题文。

3. Connect the command to evidence and a reason

Locate precisely

Identify the requested procedure, list, condition, loop or call in your own material. Check that it is the one the prompt specifies.

Explain the mechanism

Follow the actual values and control flow. A statement such as “the code is correct” does not explain what causes the result.

Respect the question

If a prompt asks for a case or an impossibility explanation, decide which is supported by your own program. Do not invent behavior to match a memorized response.

Keep material separate

These review notes are practice support. They do not belong inside a PPR and are not a prepared answer to an official prompt.

教师支持：这是一种读题和论证方法，不是可直接填入考试的万能答案。教师用学生已允许讲评的材料追问证据，不代写句子或改动已最终提交的程序。

4. Review the four written rows · 70–90 min

After the 60-minute attempt: open the 2026 scoring guidelines

Official 2026 scoring guidelines

Compare each written-response row with your response and code. Record the supporting evidence, whether it satisfies that row, and the smallest improvement to the explanation. Do not add the video and program-requirement rows to this classroom written-response result.

Written rowEvidence in my response/codeRevision target
Q1Identify it in your workWrite a specific change
Q2(a)Identify it in your workWrite a specific change
Q2(b)Identify it in your workWrite a specific change
Q2(c)Identify it in your workWrite a specific change
教师支持：2026评分指南共6个1分行；本课只复盘其中4个书面行，不误写“FRQ满分6”。四行是否满足必须依据对应原文标准和学生自身程序；课堂判断不是官方AP评分或等级预测。

5. Revise the explanation, not the submitted artifact

Choose one response that lacked evidence or a causal link. Without changing the submitted program, identify what its existing code actually supports. Rewrite the explanation to address the prompt directly; if the code cannot support the requested claim, explain that limitation honestly.

Keep the first timed attempt and the revision together. For later independent practice, choose an unused public paper from the official-paper index.

教师支持：三项全部Final后可按规则教学反馈；已提交内容不因为本课复盘就可自由改交。不要给全班同一个所谓完整答案。若在正式任务开始前用个人练习程序，明确本次结果不能证明正式PPR在考场可用。
homework: Keep the original timed response and a revised explanation for one weak written row. Identify exactly which evidence was missing.
Use a different unused public written-response paper for a later independent attempt; check its own year-specific guidelines.
If you used personal practice material, list what is still needed to simulate access to an official submitted PPR accurately.
teacherNotes: 本课在正式Create专用九小时之外：三项全Final可讲评正式作品；正式任务尚未开始可用此前个人练习并标限制；正式任务进行中必须推迟指导讲评，旧练习也不能获得practice WR反馈。
2026四个书面行与两个artifact行分开：本课只有四书面行的练习复盘，不评出“完整Create6分”或AP等级。
实际要求逐字看官方原卷，不能一律套“目的、算法、抽象”的泛答；原卷与评分直接链接，不复制题文。
60分钟期间不提示证据、不选PPR截图。其后20分钟用已允许讲评的个人材料核证据，学生本人写修订解释。

sessions.title: Mixed Timing & a Personal Repair Plan
sessions.zh: 混合限时、证据复盘与个人计划
sessions.summary: A 34-minute original mixed set followed by evidence review, targeted repair, exam readiness and an individual next-step plan.
objectives: Maintain a workable pace on a shortened mixed set.
Distinguish explained success from a correct guess.
Repair one error through a changed-case test.
Plan further practice using appropriately labeled and authorized sources.

blocks.title: Independent mixed questions
blocks.task: Complete Q21–Q40 in 34 minutes, recording confidence before feedback.

blocks.title: Evidence review
blocks.task: Classify missed and guessed answers, identify decisive evidence and explain a tempting alternative.

blocks.title: One targeted repair
blocks.task: Work a changed code or data case that matches the primary error pattern.

blocks.title: Exam readiness
blocks.task: Check school arrangements, official preview access and the appropriate route for PPR or registration issues.

blocks.title: Personal plan
blocks.task: Write two specific repair actions and a correctly labeled full-length practice opportunity.

sessions.contentHtml:
1. Complete Q21–Q40 in 34 minutes

Open the original mixed set

Work independently on all 20 questions. Record confidence and any return point. This shortened mixed set is not a complete 70-question AP multiple-choice exam and cannot predict an AP score.

教师支持：0–34分钟整段留给独立答题。34分钟近似练习读题节奏，但题量与覆盖均不等于完整考试；不要用比例换算AP等级。

2. Review evidence for 26 minutes

For each missed or guessed item, identify the first unsupported inference. Record the condition, trace step, numerical calculation or stated policy that decides the answer. Explain at least one tempting alternative, not just the correct letter.

RecordUseful evidence
Original choice and confidenceWritten before feedback
Decisive factA specific condition, value, path or permission
Why my alternative failsA contradiction or counterexample
Transfer checkA changed case with a predicted result
教师支持：34–60分钟按证据复盘。正确但不会解释的题仍需补；自信错误往往是概念误解。先修两类高价值问题，避免把所有时间用于抄完整解析。

3. Use ten minutes for one changed-case repair

Choose a case that matches your error pattern. Predict before expanding; then change one condition and solve again.

Code case

total starts at 0. In each of three repetitions, it is reset to 0 and then increased by 2. DISPLAY(total) runs after the loop. What is displayed, and what single change would make it accumulate across repetitions?

Data case

An original file is 2,000 bytes and the compressed file is 1,500 bytes. What percentage was saved, and what percentage of the original size remains?

Show answer and reasoning / 展开答案与解释

Code: output 2. Keep the initial total ← 0 before the loop, but remove the reset inside it; then three additions produce 6. With zero repetitions, that repaired version displays the initialized 0. Data: 500 bytes saved; 500 / 2,000 = 25% saved, while 75% of the original size remains.

教师支持：两例是新复习微例，挑与个人错因相关的一个做到底。代码修复保留循环前初始化，不能删掉全部初始化。压缩题必须区分节省率与剩余占比；再改一个大小验证。

4. Separate exam readiness from content repair

Use the next ten minutes to verify practical arrangements: your school’s exam details, permitted materials, access to the current official exam preview, and the status of your submitted PPR through your school. Use official sources for changes.

Official Bluebook preview guidance · Current exam information

A preview helps you learn the interface. It is not a scored practice exam. Any school registration, submission or PPR-printing issue goes to the teacher or AP coordinator; a course quiz result does not confirm those processes.

教师支持：70–80分钟处理实际信息核对，不突然开一套新题。考试时间和地点以学校通知为准；本课记录不冒充官方报名或PPR收件确认。

5. Finish with an executable personal plan

Use the final ten minutes to select two repair actions and one full-length practice opportunity. Name the source, the date, the time needed and the evidence you will check afterward. Match the action to the actual error pattern.

ActionA specific plan
Repair a conceptChoose one weak distinction and test it on two changed cases.
Repair executionChoose one short trace and explain every state transition.
Practice exam conditionsAsk your teacher to assign an available authorized full paper; label any shorter public set accurately.

Exit check: name one action you can complete next, and what observable result would show it worked. A higher repeat score alone is not enough if you remember the answers.

教师支持：最后10分钟产出可执行计划，不写“再多练习”。可用官方公开FRQ做完整书面题组；完整选择题卷依学校教师权限安排，不能把本章20题称完整模考或把受限卷公开上传。
homework: Complete the two dated repair actions in your plan and keep the changed-case evidence.
Arrange an authorized full multiple-choice paper through your teacher if available; do not relabel the 20-question set as a complete exam.
For another written-response attempt, use an unused official public paper with your own permitted personal material and its year-specific scoring guide.
teacherNotes: 20题34分钟是缩短混合练习；不等于70题120分钟完整选择题卷，不作AP等级预测。
复盘优先自信错误及猜对题；每题保留原答、自信度、决定性证据、反例与新测试。
十分钟补练只修一个具体机制，避免“看了解析”替代重新预测与验证。
Bluebook预览、学校考试安排与PPR打印均用官方/学校渠道核验；教学网站不认证报名与正式提交。
